items.headline: As a child, Dolly Parton was mocked for wearing a coat made from rags. Years later, she turned that painful humiliation into one of her most famous songs
items.teaser: Dolly Parton, who died at 80 in Nashville on August 25, came from a poor Tennessee family and often drew from her childhood experiences i…
items.story:
Dolly Parton, who died at 80 in Nashville on August 25, came from a poor Tennessee family and often drew from her childhood experiences in her music. One of her most personal memories was being mocked at school for wearing a coat her mother had made from scraps of fabric. Years later, Parton turned that painful experience into “Coat of Many Colors”, a song about family, love and finding richness in what money cannot buy.

Reporting by ET India. Read the full story at the original publication.
